newsitem.title: GERMANY: German grain intervention offers sharply lower.
newsitem.headline: German grain intervention offers sharply lower.

text.p: Sales offers into German grain intervention stores in the Nov-May 1996/97 season by Nov 8 totalled 119,099 tonnes compared with 697,290 tonnes a year earlier, state grain intervention board BLE said on Monday.
The figure described volumes accepted, but not yet delivered to stores, by the close last Friday.
They included 10,495 tonnes of soft wheat and 54,302 tonnes of rye and barley respectively.
Last year, the total sum consisted of 5,740 tonnes of soft wheat, 369,299 tonnes of rye and 322,251 tonnes of barley.
